body:
## 操作环境
仅编写和评审具体设计工件，不执行部署、镜像构建、推送或Git历史变更。场景数据为题目给定，示例摘要/域名不能当作可信生产材料。

## 给定材料
14份已脱敏只读Jenkins配置观察含声明的workflow/Git插件标识，全部作业导出disabled=true；不含脚本、凭据、核心/完整插件清单或运行日志。场景需要检出、受限测试凭据和JUnit报告。

## 操作任务
填写插件能力/已知版本/未知依赖核心矩阵，交付完整拟定Jenkinsfile、隔离升级/失败验收/整套回退单和秘密边界。只读观察不能当安装兼容或构建成功证据；未知版本必须保持待核，不改共享服务。

## 产物
- capability-version-matrix.csv
- Jenkinsfile.plan
- upgrade-runbook.md
- credential-and-failure-boundaries.md
- evidence-observations.json

## 验收方法
非作者按给定输入、逐文件完整参考、合法替代、两种实质错解和原题范围人工语义评阅；不能以标题/关键词或YAML语法正确自动判通过。平台检查仅验证导入、题型、公共字段和seed幂等。设计中的执行/测量均为待执行条件，不伪造原生命令、运行结果或生产事故。

solution_files.upgrade-runbook.md:
# Capability selection and upgrade design
Use Git for SCM capability, Pipeline components for orchestration, Credentials Binding for the narrow credential scope and JUnit for report ingestion. The sanitized exports only identify configured classes/plugin declarations and disabled jobs; they do not prove installation, enablement, controller core/Java support, dependency closure or successful builds. In particular, credentials-binding and junit are unobserved here, not proven absent or compatible. Do not select numeric upgrade versions from these declarations alone.

Request the authentic core/Java version, installed enabled plugin/dependency inventory, approved update metadata and read-only configuration backup. Choose a supported tested complete core/plugin set, pin that resolved set and its checksums in the established config-management mechanism, and rehearse on a separately approved matching isolated controller. No shared plugin installation, restart or config edit is authorized here. Verify exact SCM input, trusted credential scope, failing tests, missing reports, pause/resume and rollback of the whole compatible set before promotion. Retain old metadata/config and a restoration checkpoint, not just an individual plugin downgrade.

The reference Jenkinsfile is a complete proposed flow using existing repository scripts; those scripts must be reviewed and present before any future run. `checkout scm` requires the SCM job to resolve the reviewed revision, which must be checked in execution evidence. The label is a required existing trusted agent capability, not a label discovered on the shared node. No production deployment step exists.

[Plugin management](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/managing/plugins/) describes dependency-aware plugin management. [Git](https://plugins.jenkins.io/git/) documents SCM capability; configured SCM remains subject to exact-source verification. The version matrix deliberately leaves unknowns unresolved rather than claiming compatibility from an XML declaration.
solution_files.credential-and-failure-boundaries.md:
# Defensive boundaries and acceptance
The trusted integration-test job must be isolated from untrusted PR code and processes sharing its account. A user-controlled TRUSTED parameter is not authorization to expose secrets. The existing credential reference is test-scoped and approved; it is never a literal secret in the reference. Keep interpolation in the shell environment and command tracing disabled for secret-aware steps; log masking is only accidental disclosure mitigation, not a boundary against malicious job code.

[Credentials Binding](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/pipeline/steps/credentials-binding/) scopes environment bindings and explains their limitations. [JUnit](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/pipeline/steps/junit/) consumes test reports and can flag missing results; the plan sets allowEmptyResults=false and also requires the existing test command to fail honestly. Do not turn absent XML or a failed test into green output. Raw future evidence must record exact versions, code revision, test status and report paths without secret bytes.

Hold upgrade if core/dependency compatibility, report behavior or secret scope is unknown. Restore the previously verified full compatible set/config only through the approved isolated snapshot procedure if rehearsal fails; shared rollback/restart needs separate authorization. This authoring changed no jobs/plugins/credentials/default identities and produced no build logs. Delete only private design artifacts.

conversion.original_title: Jenkins 如何从指定阶段重新运行，哪些状态需要保留？

body:
## 操作环境
仅编写和评审具体设计工件，不执行部署、镜像构建、推送或Git历史变更。场景数据为题目给定，示例摘要/域名不能当作可信生产材料。

## 给定材料
声明式构建包含Build and verify→Prepare approved release→Record readiness；需保留原制品/参数/测试证据。现有只读XML不提供已完成构建、stash或重跑记录。

## 操作任务
交付完整拟定Jenkinsfile、stash/manifest/重跑前置合同、可选阶段与失败矩阵、重试副作用/回退执行单。保留原知识点，不声称已跑Jenkins，不因重跑选项存在跳过原测试。

## 产物
- Jenkinsfile.plan
- restart-contract.yaml
- eligibility-and-failure-matrix.csv
- restart-and-recovery.md

## 验收方法
非作者按给定输入、逐文件完整参考、合法替代、两种实质错解和原题范围人工语义评阅；不能以标题/关键词或YAML语法正确自动判通过。平台检查仅验证导入、题型、公共字段和seed幂等。设计中的执行/测量均为待执行条件，不伪造原生命令、运行结果或生产事故。

solution_files.restart-and-recovery.md:
# Stage restart applied design, not a controller-resume claim
A completed Declarative run can start a new build from an eligible top-level stage, using the original inputs. It is not a continuation of the same build number, arbitrary nested-stage selection or a replacement for Replay. The new build skips preceding stages, so prerequisites must be preserved and checked rather than silently assumed.

The reference preserves up to five completed builds' stashes and reuses verified-candidate only after verifying its manifest/digests, original revision/parameters and passed test evidence. Stash retention is bounded and not a permanent cross-job artifact repository; missing or expired stash requires rejection or fresh reviewed validation. The helper scripts are existing repository contracts, not secretly implemented bypass logic. The read-only XML observations do not prove this option is installed or this run ever happened.

The original Build and verify stage must be successfully evidenced. Do not restart downstream merely to evade a failed or missing test gate. Before retrying an external release/data stage, inspect its effect ledger and idempotency; never repeat an irreversible migration or payment because Jenkins offers a restart button. No external effects are executed in this design.

[Running Pipelines](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/running-pipelines/) defines eligibility and retained stash behavior. [Pipeline Syntax](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/pipeline/syntax/) documents preserveStashes and related options. Native validation still needs a matching authorized isolated controller, completed build/stash and raw new-run records. If those prerequisites are unavailable, the executable behavior remains unverified; this project delivers the full design/decision contract only.

After future rehearsal failure, stop the new run, preserve original and retry build IDs/effect status, and restore only its approved isolated state. Do not modify the shared controller, delete unrelated builds or force an unknown artifact through. Keep default identity/context untouched and delete only private design/rehearsal resources with explicit ownership.

solution_files.execution-and-restoration.md:
# Managed job lifecycle design, no shared job created or deleted
The CSV specifies 200 proposed names for a single managed folder. Existing ownership is REQUIRED, not invented. Read the current inventory/config/owner through approved read-only exports, compare desired and actual names, and classify creates, owned updates, protected manual jobs and explicit retirement candidates. Preview every resulting config diff and back up exact owned definitions before any separately authorized seed operation. Do not treat absence from a repository scan as a delete request.

Use reviewed Job DSL and a controlled existing seed job for repeatable job definitions, or an existing organization/multibranch scan for its supported discovery use case. JCasC covers supported controller settings; it is not a promise that all per-job definitions are automatically managed. No configuration reload or seed execution occurs here. Preserve defaults and existing permissions; scope any future authorized management identity additively to the existing folder.

[Job DSL step documentation](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/pipeline/steps/job-dsl/) supplies missing-plugin and seed-collision failure controls plus removal behavior. The reference leaves all removal actions IGNORE. Seed collision protection concerns other seed management and does not replace the separate manual-job ownership review. A valid DSL or zero-exit seed is not evidence that all 200 intended changes were safe. [JCasC](https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/managing/casc/) describes supported controller configuration, which remains separate from job inventory ownership.

For explicitly approved retirement, first disable/drain the exact owned job, preserve parameters/history/triggers and pending-event state, obtain owner/retention signoff, then apply a separately reviewed exact delete list. Exclude unrelated manual jobs and all names not in that list. Preview rollback restores only affected backed-up owned definitions with their original disabled/trigger state, verifies no duplicate runs, and never overwrites other owners. Known exported jobs being disabled does not authorize enabling or deleting them.

All native seed/API lifecycle behavior still requires matching Jenkins/Job DSL/core/plugin capabilities and an authorized isolated endpoint. This document supplies concrete input, supported configuration and review/execution contract, not run logs or proof the 200 jobs exist. Clean up only private design files here.

The supplied unit-001 DSL and seed step are explicitly a one-job pilot. They do not cover 200 rows. pilot-to-200-mapping.yaml defines the complete one-to-one CSV-to-definition mapping, reviewed expansion, unresolved-input rejection, ten explicit 20-job waves and comparison of every generated name/config/owner. Before each future seed, use only that wave's approved rendered target files, not the pilot target or a broad wildcard. Until all per-row revisions, owners and diffs are accepted, no full-inventory seed is eligible. The scenario contains no evidence that any row was actually rendered or seeded.

# Applied Zuul project configuration exercise — no scheduler run
A Zuul project identifies a configured source repository, not a process or Kubernetes project. Its project-pipeline sections select which jobs participate in pipelines already defined in the tenant/configuration. The supplied YAML maps checkout and library to a shared queue and combines template unit tests with checkout's integration job. It does not define or create the tenant, connections, pipeline managers, parent jobs or nodesets.

The two repositories interact, so the existing dependent gate pipeline must know their shared queue relationship. The integration job's required-projects identifies repositories needed by that job, but merely checking them out is not a substitute for configuring the gate relationship and change dependencies. Record the intended cross-repository revision combination and expected dependency order in future validation. Do not assert unrelated repositories must all share one global queue.

[Zuul Project documentation](https://zuul-ci.org/docs/zuul/latest/config/project.html) describes repository identity, project-pipeline jobs, templates and shared-queue relationships. [Queue documentation](https://zuul-ci.org/docs/zuul/latest/config/queue.html) explains related-project queues. A template adds project-pipeline job definitions; multiple matching project definitions can combine rather than simply replace each other. Review effective configuration to avoid unintended duplicated/extra participation. Queue semantics and exact supported config keys must match the actual installed Zuul version; latest documentation is not an installed-version declaration.

Acceptance plan: resolve canonical repository names/tenant registration; validate existing check/gate pipelines and approved parent contracts; inspect effective template/project job expansion; then, only with separately authorized isolated scheduler fixtures, observe a checkout change plus compatible/incompatible library change and the actual selected revisions/jobs/queue outcomes. Unknown pipeline, parent or dependency behavior keeps native validation unaccepted. This design does not submit changes, trigger jobs, install Zuul or claim a gate passed.

Legal restoration returns only the reviewed project/template references and queue mapping through the existing config process after checking in-flight change sets; do not bypass required gates or force merge. Retain original effective config and raw future decision evidence. Cleanup here affects private design files only.

Both checkout and library gate sections explicitly include checkout-integration, so a library-only change also schedules consumer compatibility validation with the intended revision combination. The shared queue coordinates related changes; it does not automatically copy another project's integration jobs. required-projects supplies needed repository checkouts and is not, by itself, proof the consumer test ran for a library change. Validate both effective per-project gate expansions before claiming cross-repository coverage.
